text: Getting ready for the puja
Clean the things and tools you use for your work every day.
For example, a computer, a laptop, the things you use in your business, and other tools.
Spread a clean cloth on a low stool and place whatever items you can on it.
Large equipment can be worshipped where it stands.
Keep turmeric, kumkuma, sandal paste, akshatalu, flowers, fruit and a coconut ready.
Prayer to Ganapati
Remember Ganapati and pray that the puja is completed without obstacles.
Sankalpam
Take a few akshatalu and a little water in your right hand.
Resolve that you are performing ayudha puja, wishing for dedication, skill and good results in your work.
When the sankalpam is done, release the akshatalu and water into a plate.
Sandal paste, kumkuma and flowers
Apply sandal paste, turmeric and kumkuma to the items kept for the puja, and offer flowers and akshatalu.
For delicate things like a laptop, do not put turmeric and kumkuma on them directly; offer them in a plate in front of them instead.
Incense and lamp
Show incense and the lamp before the items kept for the puja.
Naivedyam
Place fruit, a coconut or the naivedyam you have prepared in a plate.
Remembering the Devi, offer the naivedyam.
Neerajanam — harathi
Offer harathi to the items kept for the puja with camphor or the harathi lamp.
When the harathi is done, bow.
Pray to the Devi for good sense, skill and success in your work.
Share the naivedyam with your family as prasadam.
